text:
maria: quick thought — when someone saves a query from a route or model view we should persist a small "origin" breadcrumb so saved_query -> origin (route, model, pinned/variant) is explicit. helps per-route usage, telemetry joins, and quota previews.

jon: agree this would make a lot of downstream joins easier. curious how you want to handle sampling — console previews are sampled today. :thinking_face:

sam: API wise we can add an optional origin_context field on the saved_query object. minimal to avoid churn. e.g. two options: compact string or small json blob.

sam: example compact: 
```
"origin_context": "route:r-123|model:mosaic-7b|pinned:true"
```
or structured: 
```
"origin_context": {"route_id":"r-123","model":"mosaic-7b","scope":"route"}
```

ash: we should prefer the structured shape long-term but accept the compact string for now. migration plan: UI adds field when saving, backend accepts optional value and stores raw until we validate. UI should show fallback "origin unknown" for older queries.

maria: rollout idea: phase 1: backend accepts & stores origin_context (no validation) + UI persists when user clicks save (no UX change). phase 2: telemetry pipeline enriches saved_query events with route/model attributes for 10% orgs. phase 3: expand sampling to capture preview tokens for quota preview and enable per-route burn estimates.

jon: for quota previews we also need route->model mapping to estimate token burn. can we reuse existing /routes/:id/metrics endpoint?

sam: yes we can call /routes/:id/metrics to pull typical model mapping and average seq lengths. propose adding a small preview endpoint: GET /routes/:id/preview-estimate?model=mosaic-7b returns a simple JSON with tokens_per_call estimate. keeps saved_queries API light.

maria: UX note: saved query list should render a faint breadcrumb under the title: "from <route name> • <model>" and hover shows last known pin/variant + when it was captured (:clock1:). This avoids needing a special column.

ash: edge cases: queries copied between routes should update origin or keep original? i'd prefer we keep original origin but show "copied -> current route" in the UI. avoids data loss.

sam: security: origin_context is metadata only, no PII expected. still add schema white-list for fields we allow.

jon: telemetry question — do we store origin_context in the event log AND saved_query record? or just saved_query record and emit it when events happen? storing in both might help joins but duplicates data.

maria: store canonical in saved_queries table (new column). emit snapshot into console_events on save + when preview executed. that covers both reliability and joins.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature-flag scaffolding for saved_query.origin_context created on staging (CI #2371). :rocket:

ash: i'll open a tiny schema migration PR to add origin_context (nullable text) and a feature flag gate. will also include a small index on route_id if present.

sam: i'll draft the API contract and example responses, plus a small frontend patch to attach origin when saving from route/model views.

maria: thanks — let's aim for a canary to 10% of orgs next week. i'll add an entry in the rollout doc and the telemetry ticket. :thumbsup:

jon: sounds good. ping me if you want me to wire the quota-preview endpoint to the console cost UI.

ash: PRs incoming.

maria: awesome — quick follow-ups in the thread if anyone hits blockers.
